title: narration bound to approved copy, confirmed pronunciations, transcript check with uncertainty, no default cloning

approved_copy.text: Make a whole film from one sentence.

lines.text: Make an entire film from one sentence.

heard: Make an entire film from one sentence.

expect.binding: line 1 bound; line 2 diverged (message names the approved text); line 3 not_approved_copy; ok false
expect.glossary: 'Rasan' is applied only because the user confirmed it ('Meet Rah-sahn AI.'); 'AI' is returned in proposed_unconfirmed and NOT applied
expect.transcript: status checked, uncertain true; the basis names the transcriber and says its own errors look like narration errors; line 1 reports 'Rasan' may have been heard as 'Raisin' and names[Rasan].status not_heard_as_written (a prompt to listen, not a verdict)
expect.no_transcript: transcriptCheck with heard [] -> status unchecked (not a pass)
expect.cloning: cloned_unauthorized -> ok false with an error; cloned_authorized -> ok true; stock -> ok true
